> Cloudflare-first TypeScript stack handbook for humans and AI agents.

Docs: https://stack.fenod.fr

## Core defaults

Node 22, pnpm, TanStack Start, Hono, ORPC, Drizzle, D1, Better Auth, Tailwind v4, shadcn/ui, TanStack AI, Cloudflare Workers/Pages, Alchemy, Infisical, Ultracite, tsgo, Vitest, Playwright.
